faqs.a: Enterprise tele-ICU and virtual critical care provider serving 145+ hospitals in 35 states. Formerly known as Advanced ICU Care (founded 2006). They provide remote intensivist coverage, virtual nursing, and patient monitoring for ICUs and acute care units.

faqs.q: Is Hicuity Health for mental health?
faqs.a: No. Hicuity Health specializes in critical care and ICU telemedicine, not mental health. If you're looking for telepsychiatry for hospitals, consider Array Behavioral Care, e-Psychiatry, or Encounter Telehealth instead.

Tele-ICU (remote intensivist coverage), virtual nursing, virtual sitter (fall prevention monitoring), telemetry monitoring, smart device monitoring, and shared services. All focused on acute/critical care settings.
145+ hospitals across 35 states. 1.2 million patient interactions annually, caring for 110,000+ patients. They claim to have saved partner hospitals over $60M by reducing ICU length of stay.
